title: Probability and Statistics
description: This module develops probability theory for modelling uncertainty and designing probabilistic models for prediction. It emphasises mathematical foundations combined with practical application. Topics include random variables, hypothesis testing, confidence intervals, and Markov chains.
learning_objectives: Describe probability notions in terms of sample spaces
Design simple probability models and estimate parameters from data
Perform hypothesis tests and draw scientific conclusions
topics: Discrete random variables and their probability distributions
Continuous random variables and their probability distributions
